caption: The drawing depicts a rooster-shaped object standing on a horizontal bar with a vertical support beneath it. The rooster is shown in profile, facing left, with detailed features including a comb, beak, eye, wing, body, legs, feet, and a prominently arched tail with layered feathers. The coloring consists primarily of blue-green tones, with rusty orange-brown streaks and highlights accentuating the contours and feather patterns throughout the rooster’s body and tail. The background is a plain, off-white or light beige color with no additional objects or scenery, keeping all focus on the single, centrally placed rooster figure.
title: Copper Cock Weather Vane
